"""Preserve build drift, restore only our generated files, seed a new candidate."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OLD=Path('/Users/a77/fwp-wt-wave2-re06-0923')
NEW=Path('/Users/a77/fwp-wt-re06-timer-assets-0923')
REV='f9ce5c6b296492b423400ad66d333784a4be13bc'
HTML='intelligence/api/static/index.html'
OLDJS='intelligence/api/static/assets/index-o4AWiRNg.js'
NEWJS='intelligence/api/static/assets/index-BobixB9S.js'
def git(tree,*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(tree),*args])
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
assert git(OLD,'rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==REV
assert git(NEW,'rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==REV and not git(NEW,'status','--porcelain')
status=git(OLD,'status','--porcelain','-z','--untracked-files=all')
assert {row[3:].decode() for row in status.split(b'\0') if row}=={HTML,OLDJS,NEWJS}
assert not (OLD/OLDJS).exists()
raw_old=git(OLD,'show',REV+':'+OLDJS)
raw_new=(OLD/NEWJS).read_bytes()
assert b'workbench-activity-v1' in raw_old and b'activity-timer' not in raw_old
assert b'workbench-activity-v2' in raw_new and b'activity-timer' in raw_new
snapshot=ROOT/'generated-static'
snapshot.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
for name in [HTML,NEWJS]:
    dst=snapshot/Path(name).name
    shutil.copyfile(OLD/name,dst)
    shutil.copyfile(dst,NEW/name)
(NEW/OLDJS).unlink()
record={'at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'revision':REV,'finding':'Tracked static bundle still uses v1 instead of source timer v2.',
        'status_after_build':status.decode(),'old_bundle':{'path':OLDJS,'sha256':sha(raw_old)},
        'generated_bundle':{'path':NEWJS,'sha256':sha(raw_new)},
        'generated_index_sha256':sha((OLD/HTML).read_bytes()),'product_source_edited':False,
        'new_candidate_tree':str(NEW),'new_candidate_base':REV,'full_acceptance_status':'BLOCKED_ARTIFACT_IDENTITY_DRIFT'}
subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(OLD),'restore','--source='+REV,'--',HTML,OLDJS],check=True)
assert (snapshot/Path(NEWJS).name).read_bytes()==(OLD/NEWJS).read_bytes()
(OLD/NEWJS).unlink()
assert not git(OLD,'status','--porcelain')
record['original_candidate_restored_clean']=True
(ROOT/'artifact-drift.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
